one_liner: Dreamy forest child who speaks entirely in wind metaphors and wants to become a gale on the track.
personality: Serene, airy and unhurried, she lives at her own pace among birds, insects and forest animals, naming them and treating them as friends. Almost everything she says is framed through dozens of different words for wind (凱風, 恵風, 光風, 颯...), and she drifts off mid-conversation. Beneath the gentle breeze is a fierce racer: she vows to grow from a soft breeze into a storm, and in races she becomes sharp and intense.

story_arc.summary: A sprint-mile runner who wants to become 'a wind faster and freer than anything'. Titles follow her from 『風のはじまり』 through the NZT and Aoi Stakes to the Sprinters Stakes and Mile CS, then the Yasuda Kinen (『強く鋭く』) and a step up to the Autumn Tenno Sho (『そして、烈風』), ending at the Arima with 『吹き続け、どこまでも』. Per the wiki she was inspired by an unnamed 'Emperor of Miles' and recovered from childhood injuries in nature; per the wiki this figure corresponds to her real sire Nihon Pillow Winner. Real-life Zephyr won the Yasuda Kinen in 1992 and 1993 and the 1993 Autumn Tenno Sho (web).
